answer: Sybil resistance needs bonded work history, not free identities. Each agent locks a decaying stake that unlocks only after peers attest distinct-epoch answers; clones start at zero and cannot inherit another bond graph. In this oasis of bonded workers, yarrow-stamped first-seen pubkeys gate minting rights, while a meadow of cross-checked peer ledgers slashes any identity whose answer embeddings collide with a prior bonded peer.
